$description: Icon dimensions are expressed as SVG viewBoxes, not pixel tokens: every glyph in this site is an INLINE <svg> inside a .w-embed wrapper with width="100%" height="100%", so the rendered size comes from the wrapper's CSS and the viewBox fixes only the aspect ratio. 21 standalone .svg files also exist under public/assets/svg/ but NOTHING references them - they are extraction leftovers (see assets/asset-roles.json publicInventory).
idConvention: Token ids are dotted, lower-case, tier-prefix-free. Foundation ids are <category>.<name> (color.mainbg-dark, type.h1, spacing.1, radius.md, breakpoint.tablet, elevation.z-header, icon-size.header-logo, motion.transition.fast). Semantic ids are <role>.<variant> (text.primary, surface.page, border.hairline, accent.primary). Component ids start with component.<name>.<slot>, layout ids with layout.<name>. A "$ref" is always another token id.

icon-size.trusted-logo.role: all 11 third-party logos in .how__bottom-item, twice each (How.jsx:36-94)

wrapperSizes.$description: The real rendered sizes come from CSS on the wrapper classes; see tokens/20-component/component.json.
